scope: Prospective evidence only; immutable source context, no computation, physical procedure, scientific acceptance or remote action.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Matched sealed article, coupon and assembly states
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E1 and E2; docs/MEMBER-CENSUS.md Film, close-up fittings and outfit
entries.units: article/component identity; enclosed volume m3; pressure Pa
entries.method: Request article/barrier/joint/seal identities and assembly/configuration history with declared coupon/component/full-cell boundaries and uncertainty provenance.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A membrane coupon or component observation does not establish whole assembled-cell retention; drawn parts and unknown outfit do not complete the sealed configuration.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Pressure observations and calibrated temperature/time basis
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E1 — what a sealed vacuum cell actually weighs
entries.units: pressure Pa; temperature K; timestamp; interval s
entries.method: Request raw synchronized pressure/temperature records, sensor ranges/locations, calibration, drift, timebase/synchronization uncertainty and missing-data flags for the same sealed configuration.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A pressure log is an observation channel, not an identified leak rate or demonstrated service life. Missing calibration or thermal/time context prevents attribution.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Ingress, outgassing and permeation kept distinct
entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E1 build sequence and pass/fail paragraph (outgassing versus leakage)
entries.units: pressure Pa; gas/species identity; time s; evidence identity
entries.method: Request independently attributable gas-source/provenance records, material/barrier/interface states and matched pressure/temperature history with uncertainty; retain unresolved attribution.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: E1 expects early outgassing rather than leakage and requires separation. This method separately reserves a permeation channel; the cited E1/E2 text does not name it. Pressure rise alone cannot choose between ingress, outgassing, permeation or thermal/sensor effects.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E1 printed demonstrator build sequence
entries.units: temperature K; humidity fraction; state/record identity; time s
entries.method: Request documented material moisture/dry-state, storage and conditioning history with calibration and uncertainty, linked to the same sealed article and observation interval.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: Published dry-state and bake-out language is retained as source context; this paper selects no material, seal, temperature, conditioning sequence or physical procedure.

entries.existing_model_reference: docs/VERIFICATION-PLAN.md E1 months of pressure log; E2 permanent creep
entries.units: observation interval s; configuration identity; uncertainty units per quantity
entries.method: Request duration/coverage, environmental and configuration changes, raw observations, instrument drift and uncertainty with retained failures and gaps before any duration transfer.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: A short record or coupon result is not a demonstrated assembled-cell service lifetime. No leak-rate, pressure-rise or lifetime extrapolation is calculated.

entries.requirement_or_owner: Proposed degradation allowance versus adopted criteria
entries.units: source/decision identity; uncertainty units per quantity
entries.method: Request explicit separately recorded criterion ownership, source version and adoption/acceptance disposition with matched observations and uncertainty; retain proposed status until such evidence exists.
entries.missing_comparison_or_applicability: The source says the vacuum-degradation allowance is not chosen and labels its example proposed. This paper adopts no allowance or prorated threshold; physical acceptance remains UNKNOWN.
